payload.title: The security-boundary adapter's only exemption is a per-file allowlist that switches off every rule for the file (the endpoint rules, both peer rules, the dangerous-html rule and the raw-import rule), so the two intentional peer hits can be removed only by also silencing every present and future finding of that file, and the default input carries no allowlist so they are re-emitted on every run.
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.ts:145 (the allowlist is a set of file paths)
tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.ts:206-210 (one per-file flag is passed to all five analyzers)
tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.ts:269-271 (the endpoint analyzer returns before every finding when the file is allowlisted)
tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.ts:320-322 (the peer analyzer returns for an allowlisted file)
tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.ts:542 (the dangerous-html finding is gated by the same flag)
tools/aria-adapters/security-boundary-adapter.ts:641 (the raw-import finding is gated by the same flag)
payload.rule_violated: A boundary detector's exemption must name the route and the rule it covers; a file-wide switch is a silent-miss hole in the thing that guards authorization (CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach tier 1 and 2).
payload.notes: To retire the intentional LeaveResolver.createLeaveRequest hit (11 of 12 peers carry a boundary) a maintainer lists leave.resolver.ts; from then on a new unguarded mutation or a @Public write added to that resolver, which the endpoint rules and the peer rule would flag, is silent and the observation merely records allowlisted. Without the allowlist the intentional hit is re-emitted and judged every cycle. Close condition: Replace the file allowlist by an exemption keyed by file, route name and rule id (or a marker decorator the adapter reads) applied per finding, and add tests that an exemption for one route and one rule leaves another route's finding and another rule's finding in the same file intact. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 4). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
